games.title: Solar Tower
games.description: Solar Tower — a retro arcade CRT precision block stacking game. Tap to drop each block on the one below. Overhang gets sliced off — miss completely and the tower falls.

games.title: Midnight Lift Duty
games.description: Midnight Lift Duty — a molten lava elevator dispatch game. You're the lift operator in a busy tower. Collect waiting people and drop them at their floor before anyone's patience runs out.

games.title: Feral Espresso Bar
games.description: Feral Espresso Bar — a desert mirage cafe order assembly game. You're on bar during the morning rush. Build each drink by adding its ingredients in the exact order on the ticket, before the customer walks.

games.title: Deep Depot
games.description: Deep Depot — a deep-space recycling line sorting game. You're running the sorting line at a recycling plant. Steer each item down the chute into the matching bin — three missorts and the line shuts down.

games.title: Wild Signal Box
games.description: Wild Signal Box — a arctic aurora junction signal control game. You control the lights at a busy crossroads. Switch which road gets the green — let two streams into the junction at once and they crash.

games.title: Velvet Rift
games.description: Velvet Rift — a cozy pastel omni-directional dodge & collect game. Glide to dodge the incoming shards and scoop the glowing motes. One hit and it's over.

games.title: Origami Rush
games.description: Origami Rush — a origami paper lane-switch dodge & collect game. Swipe or use arrows to switch lanes. Grab the orbs, dodge the spikes.

games.title: Moonlit Bounce
games.description: Moonlit Bounce — a moonlit rooftops endless brick-breaker game. Bounce the ball to shatter every brick. Clear a wave and a denser one drops. Miss the ball and it's over.

games.title: Coral Reaction
games.description: Coral Reaction — a coral reef color-target tap test game. Tap the glowing rings before they fade. Never tap a crossed one, and don't let too many good ones slip away.

games.title: Crystal Leap
games.tagline: Easy to learn. Hard to master.
games.description: Crystal Leap — a crystal cavern tap-to-flap through gaps game. Tap (or Space) to flap and thread every gap. Touch a wall or the floor and you're done.

games.description: Vaporwave Heights — a vaporwave sunset precision block stacking game. Tap to drop each block on the one below. Overhang gets sliced off — miss completely and the tower falls.

games.title: Voidfall
games.description: Slide through a storm of neon shards, scoop glowing orbs, and survive as the void speeds up.
